The StbM shall calculate the current value of a Time Base based on the Main Tuple and the current rate correction term according to: • TL = TG Sync + (TV - TV Sync ) * r With: • TL = Current value of the Time Base • TV = Current value of the Virtual Local Time • TV Sync = Virtual Local Time part of the Main Time Tuple • TG Sync = Global Time part of the Main Time Tuple • r = Current rate for correcting the local instance of the Time Base
